:::{#thm-ci-OR}

#### Confidence interval for an odds ratio

In a [logistic regression model](#def-logistic-regression),
let $\vx$ and $\vxs$ be two covariate patterns,
and let $(L, R)$ be a 95% [confidence interval](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/inference.html#def-confidence-interval) for the logarithm of the [odds ratio](binary-outcome-associations.qmd#def-OR), $\logf{\ror(\vx,\vxs)}$.
Then:

$$\ror(\vx,\vxs) \in (e^L, e^R)$$

is a 95% confidence interval for $\ror(\vx,\vxs)$.

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-ci-OR.

:::
